This was my first time getting my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). Dr. Fahsai was incredibly gentle; it didn't hurt at all! She gave me advice and explained the order of procedures (because I had several cavities 😅).

The receptionist was smiling and friendly, making me feel comfortable from the initial consultation before the cleaning.

The clinic itself is spacious with high ceilings and plenty of seating; it didn't feel cramped at all.

Overall, I was impressed with both the teeth cleaning and the service. I would recommend this clinic for anyone planning to get their teeth cleaned or who is afraid of teeth cleaning. 😊

P.S. There's parking available. It's in the city center, near Dara School and Central Festival.
